d.d: The feel of the weight of something; heaviness.
d.x: A high quality hammer should have good balance and heft.

d.d: The force exerted by an object due to gravitation; weight.
To lift or lift up (something, especially a heavy object).
d.x: He hefted the sack of concrete into the truck.

d.d: To test the weight of (something) by lifting.
To evaluate or test (someone or something).
With heft; heavy, strong, vigorous, mighty, impressive
d.x: He can throw a hefty punch.
They use some hefty bolts to hold up road signs.

d.d: Possessing physical strength and weight; rugged and powerful; powerfully or heavily built.
d.x: He was a tall, hefty man.
